Shoriful Islam to Ryan Rickelton, out Caught by Jaker Ali!! Shoriful Islam strikes right after the drinks break. Gets the in-form batsman - Ryan Rickelton. A short and wide ball outside off, plenty of room to play with. Ryan Rickelton throws the kitchen sink at it and cuts it straight to Jaker Ali at deep point. He moves across to his right and takes a well-judged catch. South Africa have lost half their side with the lead in excess of 200. Ryan Rickelton c Jaker Ali b Shoriful Islam 20(24) [4s-3]
